targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(bucket, '1h') AS time, module AS metric, sum(n)::float AS value FROM caib.events_5m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroup(bucket, '1h') AS time, module AS metric, (sum(n) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'failure'))::float / nullif(sum(n), 0) AS value FROM caib.events_5m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT actor, module, sum(n) AS events, sum(failures) AS failures FROM caib.actors_1h WHERE bucket > now() - interval '24 hours' AND actor IS NOT NULL GROUP BY actor, module ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT severity, count(*)::int AS alerts FROM detect.alerts WHERE status = 'open' GROUP BY severity ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['critical','high','medium','low','info'], severity)

panels.title: Landing backlog
panels.description: Rows waiting for the loader. Sustained growth = loader down or DB overloaded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::int AS backlog FROM ingest.landing

panels.title: Dead letter (total)
panels.description: Envelopes the loader refused. Non-empty = a mapping bug somewhere.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::int AS dead FROM ingest.dead_letter

SELECT job_id, proc_name, pid, start_time, finish_time, sqlerrcode, err_message FROM timescaledb_information.job_errors WHERE finish_time > now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY finish_time DESC LIMIT 50
